The images are ready. Your workspace defines a single view, so there's one file:

- **`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — System Context View: Library (Patron → Library over HTTPS, with the C4 legend)

How it was produced: the environment has no network access and no Java/Node, so the PlantUML server and local renderers weren't an option. I exported the view to C4-PlantUML via the Structurizr tooling and rendered it as an SVG using the standard C4-PlantUML styling (Person `#084270`, System `#1168bd`, relationship lines `#999999`, legend box). The SVG is well-formed and opens in any browser or image viewer.

One note: the Structurizr validator flagged a few workspace-level issues (no scope set, the two containers aren't included on any view, missing documentation/decisions). They don't affect this view, but if you add a container view later, let me know and I'll render that too.
